ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of recent fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and autism fraud kickback claims.
questions: What are the financial connections between entities involved in these schemes?
How did the perpetrators launder their funds?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and connections between entities, we may uncover a larger network of fraudulent activity in Minnesota.
